# @three-ws/knock

> Reach a real person, and pay their price to do it. Every three.ws account can publish a priced door; paying it buys one message through, delivered in person by their 3D companion. Wallet-agnostic: bring any x402 client.

@three-ws/knock is a JavaScript library from three.ws. Install: `npx -y @three-ws/knock`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-knock/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/three-ws-knock/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/three-ws-knock/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-knock/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
